title: Checking the calendar on a tablet
notes: Dim, low-key close shot of a tablet showing a month calendar in dark mode ('jul. 2022', Spanish weekday labels, tiny out-of-focus event labels); a man's hand (suit cuff) with a stylus hovers and points at dates; shallow depth of field, slow handheld drift. 0.5-2.5s pen enters and points at the top area; 3.0s pen across the centre of the screen; 5.5s hand lifts the pen to the upper right; 8.0s pen points mid-screen; 10.5-11.5s pen moves to the lower right. Fits 'change the schedule you can' (reviewing a calendar). No face. The calendar shows no app name, but the row of small app icons on the tablet's taskbar (bottom right, out of focus) is recognisable by colour: a red play-button icon and a gradient camera icon are clearest at 10.5-11.5s. They drift from about x1170 to x1700 over the clip, so blur_box covers that whole band. Already dark, cool and green-grey; light grading only.

backup.title: The hands of a man taking notes with a pen on a cafe table with a black coffee cup in the back
backup.why: Man's hands writing notes in a spiral notebook at a cafe table, daylight. A 'CPS / Canon Professional Services' logo on a small black notebook drifts across the lower left until about 8s (needs a moving blur), and a green-screen device sits at the left edge before 1.5s. Also close to group B st23 (99910, hands writing notes).

title: A young smiling woman enjoys social media scrolling on her red phone laying on the comfy bed at midnight
notes: Night bedroom lit by a warm table lamp (orange wall, padded headboard). A young woman in pink satin pyjamas sits up in bed. 3.0-6.5s she smiles at a red phone; the back of the phone faces camera in a red case, the screen is never visible and no logo shows. About 7.0-7.5s she puts the phone aside and yawns behind her hand; 9.5s looks down smiling; 11.5-13.8s big yawn and arms-up stretch. Fits 'staying up late and getting up late on weekends' (late-night phone use, then a sleepy stretch that also reads as a late wake-up). The woman's face is clearly visible, which the rules allow. Before about 2.5s a dark foreground edge covers the right ~20% of the frame, so start at 3.0 or later. Mixkit's default 1080 URL was missing; I fetched the official 1920x1080 file through the download page using the shared lock. Already dim: cool it down and desaturate the orange wall and pink satin.

backup.title: Young woman waking up in her bed
backup.why: Young woman slowly waking and stretching under a duvet in soft grey daylight. Only 10.1s long, bare shoulders, and she sits up showing her bare back at about 9.5s, so only 0-9.0s is usable (short of 10.8; would need speed 0.83 or a shorter cut).

title: Alarm clock outside, time lapse
notes: Locked-off shot of a chrome twin-bell alarm clock (black dial, 'QUARTZ') against a blue sky with drifting clouds. Time-lapse: the hands advance from about 7:25 to 7:55, a typical wake-up time, and the clouds move steadily. Fits the NIH line about keeping weekday and weekend sleep schedules similar, within about an hour (a clock as the schedule). No logos or faces. Bright daylight: darken and desaturate. Caveat: the clock sits in the lower half (dial at about y600-960), so the low bottom subtitles will cover the lower part of the dial (7/6/5). Consider a slight upward reframe or a 110% scale anchored at the top.

backup.title: Woman turning off her alarm clock
backup.why: Digital alarm clock reading 7:00 on a nightstand; a woman's hand (red nails) switches it off at 2.8-4.7s, with no face in the first ~6s ('fixed wake time'). After ~6.6s it pans to the woman in bed. She is the same actress as group A st13 (42896), so use only 0-6s. Warm daylight; I did not check small text on the clock.

title: Woman waking up while turning off her alarm clock
notes: Bright, white, high-key bedroom. A middle-aged woman is propped up in bed, groggy (1.2-2.5s eyes closed, grimacing). 3.0-6.5s she stretches her arm out toward the blue alarm clock on the white nightstand at the left to silence it. 8.0-9.5s she collapses face-down into the pillow. Fits 'don't cut the sleep you need just to keep the wake-up time' (sleep-deprived, dragging herself up to the alarm). The woman's face is visible (allowed). No logos. Very bright: darken heavily, cool and desaturate.

backup.title: Silencing the alarm clock in the morning
backup.why: Same blue alarm-clock set: a sleepy woman's hand reaches in and silences the clock beside a table lamp, bright. Only 6.6s long (speed 0.8 for 8.3s).

title: Man falls asleep hugging his wife
notes: Warm, lamp-lit bedroom at night. A woman sleeps in the foreground (face visible, eyes closed). Behind her a man in a dark T-shirt sits against the headboard texting; 0-4s his face is cut off by the top edge and in shadow. 5.5s he puts the phone away; 6.5-9.0s he turns his back to camera and reaches for the bedside lamp; about 9.1s the lamp switches off. HARD END 9.3s: at about 9.4-9.5s he turns toward camera and his face is clearly visible (a Black man, clearly not the protagonist), and after that he lies down and hugs her. Fits 'don't fall asleep too late, even on weekends' (phone down, light off). If the real line is shorter than ~9s the lamp-off will be cut; to keep it, play at speed ~1.15-1.3, or start at 1.5-2.0s and still stop at 9.3s source time. The green hardcover book in the foreground is out of focus with no legible text. Grade: cool the warm amber and desaturate.

backup.title: Interior of a department room

title: Therapist in his office talking to the camera
notes: Bright clinic office. A young Asian woman doctor in a white coat sits at a white desk with arms folded, speaking to camera (lips move); she smiles more toward 12-15s. On the desk: a closed laptop (no visible logo), a notebook, a stethoscope and small plants; shelves with white binders behind. Static camera, one continuous take (single clip for the whole slot). A neutral, non-alarming 'go see a doctor' image: no hospital logos, needles, blood or patient. The woman's face is visible (allowed). Note: the direct-to-camera framing can feel a bit like an ad. It is the only Free neutral doctor clip I found (17469, 17540 and 48385 are Restricted; 4582 shows a sick child's face). I found no Free snoring clip without a clear male or patient face (48731 is Restricted and shows a man's face; 42972 and 42979 show a man's face; 33468 is Restricted). Grade: darken, cool, desaturate the beige.

backup.title: Interior of a department room

title: Woman stretching in the morning before starting her day
notes: Bright morning bedroom, seen from behind: a woman in a white camisole and pyjama trousers stands at a big window with sheer blinds, next to a chrome arc floor lamp, with an unmade bed in the foreground (tiny alarm clock on it). 0.0-1.0s arms stretched overhead; 2.0-4.9s she adjusts her hair, still in back view. From ~5.6s she turns to profile and at ~7s walks toward camera (not used). Fits 'let's go back to that first Saturday' (Saturday-morning light through the window); calm for the 2/2 centre lines. No face in the used span. No logos. Bright and warm-pink: darken and desaturate, keeping a soft morning glow.

title: Alarm clock on a table while time flies by
notes: Locked-off close shot of a chrome twin-bell alarm clock (navy dial, 'QUARTZ') on a wooden shelf next to a small lit candle, with a mint instant camera behind and a butterfly print at the left (Spanish text in the bottom-left corner and a gold script word on the print). Time-lapse: the second hand sweeps quickly and the minute hand creeps toward midnight (about 11:35 to 11:50); only the hands move. Fits 'have you kept pushing your bedtime later?' (time slipping by late at night, candle-lit); calm for the 3/3 centre lines. The camera's 'instax mini 8' text is legible, so blur_box covers it for the whole clip (static shot). Warm brown and candle tones: cool and desaturate.

title: Slow aerial tour through a mist-covered forest
notes: Slow drone glide over a dark conifer forest in early morning, with banks of mist rolling between the trees; the sky strip at the top is very bright (pull it down). 3-8s the trees are clear in the foreground with mist behind; 10-14.8s the mist thickens and swallows the forest. Fits 'how we'll get through the next day isn't visible at that moment' (the view fogs over); calm. No logos or people. Grade: darken the sky, cool and desaturate.

title: Man stands in the shadows
notes: Pure black silhouette of a man (bushy, curly hair; jacket), head bowed, standing in a window frame with a striped office tower at the left and a warm orange sky; slow sideways drift. 2.0-11.2s he stays still with his head lowered, a reflective pose. No facial features at all. Covers lines 1-3 ('얼마나 오래 깨어 있었는지와 함께 / 어떤 상태로 하루를 보냈는지도 / 돌아보면 좋겠습니다.'). Caveats: (a) the hair silhouette is bushier than the protagonist's short hair; (b) it looks similar to group A st08 (4808, a man's silhouette at sunset). title: Gliding along a quiet asphalt road at dawn, the soft, golden light of the rising sun iluminates the highway.
